_meta.description: Predefined local rules used to produce relative, teaching-purpose engineering effort estimates for the Product Discovery Agent demo. These are NOT real engineering commitments or production estimates.

expected_work: Introduce a theming layer (design tokens/CSS variables) if one does not already exist.
Audit all components, charts, and third-party widgets for hardcoded colors.
Add a theme toggle and persist user preference.
Re-test contrast ratios for accessibility compliance in the new theme.
risks: Third-party embedded widgets may not support theming, creating visual inconsistency.
Scope can silently expand if many legacy components have hardcoded styles.
testing_requirements: Visual regression testing across both themes
dark_mode.platforms_note: Effort increases if both web and native mobile clients must be themed consistently.

expected_work: Stand up native (or cross-platform) mobile codebase and CI/CD pipeline.
Design mobile-specific navigation and a reduced feature set for v1.
Implement authentication, offline caching, and push notifications.
Establish app store review and release processes.
dependencies: Public/stable API surface for mobile clients
risks: App store review timelines are outside the team's direct control.
Maintaining feature parity across web and mobile increases long-term maintenance cost.
Native mobile requires ongoing OS-version compatibility work.
mobile_app.platforms_note: A scoped 'lite' app (e.g., approvals and alerts only) is meaningfully lower effort than a full-feature native rebuild.

expected_work: Integrate a transcription and summarization model/service.
Build a review/edit UI so users can correct AI-generated summaries.
Design data retention and deletion policy for transcripts.
Wire summaries into existing task/follow-up workflows.
dependencies: Data retention policy sign-off from legal/privacy
risks: Summarization accuracy varies by audio quality and speaker overlap.
Storing transcripts introduces new privacy and compliance obligations.
Users may over-trust AI summaries without reviewing them.
testing_requirements: Summary accuracy spot checks against human-written notes
ai_meeting_summary.platforms_note: Effort estimate assumes an existing call-recording pipeline; effort would be High if recording infrastructure must also be built.

expected_work: Design a step-by-step checklist with progress tracking.
Add contextual tooltips or a guided product tour for first-run.
Instrument analytics events per onboarding step to measure drop-off.
Write updated help-center content aligned to the new flow.
risks: Poorly tuned tooltips can feel intrusive and hurt experience if over-used.
Checklist can go stale if not updated as the product evolves.
testing_requirements: A/B test of checklist vs. current flow
onboarding.platforms_note: Effort is largely UI/UX and instrumentation work; low dependency on backend changes.

expected_work: Add a server-side or client-side PDF rendering step for existing report views.
Apply consistent branding/layout template to exported PDFs.
Add an export button and background job status indicator for larger reports.
risks: Complex charts or tables may not render cleanly in PDF format without extra layout work.
Large reports could require async/background generation to avoid timeouts.
testing_requirements: Visual QA of PDF layout across report types
Performance testing for large report exports
export_pdf.platforms_note: Effort is similar across web platforms; native mobile export is out of scope for this estimate.
